    @[simp]
    theorem ZFib.External.OperatorAlgebra.CEP.Faithful.bocaDefectReducedProductRho_headAction {m : ℕ} {X : Type} {H : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] [DecidableEq X] (phi : X → CompletelyPositiveMap (Fin m → ℂ) (End H)) (hphi : ∀ (x : X), (phi x) 1 = 1) (rhoDefect : (x : X) → BocaDefectRho (phi x) ⋯) [(x : X) → Fintype (HeadIsnt x)] [(x : X) → DecidableEq (HeadIsnt x)] (piHead : (x : X) → (Fin m → ℂ) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] EndC (bocaDefectHeadTensor phi hphi rhoDefect x)) (x : X) (a : Fin m → ℂ) :
    bocaDefectReducedProductRho phi hphi rhoDefect piHead x a = (basedConjugateOperator (bocaDefectFullHeadUnitary phi hphi rhoDefect x)) ((piHead x) a)

    Defining head action: after the committed full-head unitary W_x, bocaDefectReducedProductRho x a is exactly the conjugated head operator.

    @[simp]
    theorem ZFib.External.OperatorAlgebra.CEP.Faithful.bocaDefectReducedWordOperator_tailAction_nil {m : ℕ} {X : Type} {H : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] [DecidableEq X] (phi : X → CompletelyPositiveMap (Fin m → ℂ) (End H)) (hphi : ∀ (x : X), (phi x) 1 = 1) (rhoDefect : (x : X) → BocaDefectRho (phi x) ⋯) [(x : X) → Fintype (HeadIsnt x)] [(x : X) → DecidableEq (HeadIsnt x)] (piHead : (x : X) → (Fin m → ℂ) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] EndC (bocaDefectHeadTensor phi hphi rhoDefect x)) :
    bocaDefectReducedWordOperator phi hphi rhoDefect piHead [] = 1

    Defining tail recursion, empty word case. This is the current public action API for the word operator; it does not yet identify a separate tail-supported operator on HeadIsnt x.

    source
    @[simp]
    theorem ZFib.External.OperatorAlgebra.CEP.Faithful.bocaDefectReducedWordOperator_tailAction_cons {m : ℕ} {X : Type} {H : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] [DecidableEq X] (phi : X → CompletelyPositiveMap (Fin m → ℂ) (End H)) (hphi : ∀ (x : X), (phi x) 1 = 1) (rhoDefect : (x : X) → BocaDefectRho (phi x) ⋯) [(x : X) → Fintype (HeadIsnt x)] [(x : X) → DecidableEq (HeadIsnt x)] (piHead : (x : X) → (Fin m → ℂ) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] EndC (bocaDefectHeadTensor phi hphi rhoDefect x)) (y : X) (b : Fin m → ℂ) (word : CEP.BocaReducedWord X m) :
    bocaDefectReducedWordOperator phi hphi rhoDefect piHead ((y, b) :: word) = bocaDefectReducedProductRho phi hphi rhoDefect piHead y b * bocaDefectReducedWordOperator phi hphi rhoDefect piHead word

    Defining tail recursion, cons case. For a typed reduced tail with head != x, the missing next API is the reindexed operator on the HeadIsnt x tail whose conjugate is this recursive product.

    theorem ZFib.External.OperatorAlgebra.CEP.Faithful.bocaDefect_vacuum_factorization_of_reduced_support {m : ℕ} {X : Type} {H : Type v} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] [DecidableEq X] (phi : X → CompletelyPositiveMap (Fin m → ℂ) (End H)) (hphi : ∀ (x : X), (phi x) 1 = 1) (rhoDefect : (x : X) → BocaDefectRho (phi x) ⋯) [(x : X) → Fintype (HeadIsnt x)] [(x : X) → DecidableEq (HeadIsnt x)] (piHead : (x : X) → (Fin m → ℂ) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] EndC (bocaDefectHeadTensor phi hphi rhoDefect x)) (hsupport : bocaDefectTailCompressionSupportReduced phi hphi rhoDefect piHead) (x : X) (a : Fin m → ℂ) (word : ReducedBocaWord X m) (hhead : ¬word.headFactor? = some x) :
    (operatorCompressionCP (bocaDefectVacuumInclusion phi hphi rhoDefect)) (bocaDefectReducedProductRho phi hphi rhoDefect piHead x a * bocaDefectReducedWordOperator phi hphi rhoDefect piHead word.word) = (operatorCompressionCP (bocaDefectVacuumInclusion phi hphi rhoDefect)) (bocaDefectReducedProductRho phi hphi rhoDefect piHead x a) * (operatorCompressionCP (bocaDefectVacuumInclusion phi hphi rhoDefect)) (bocaDefectReducedWordOperator phi hphi rhoDefect piHead word.word)

    Once the missing head/tail support factorization is supplied for a typed reduced tail, the desired vacuum factorization is exactly the reduced support interface consumed by the Boca formula layer.
